headline: Spanish Usage-First Verbs Master
threshold: Sixty verb lemmas in descending Spanish Web 2011 corpus frequency, with new usage scenes. Inflected forms count together; frequency varies by genre and region.

lessons.title: 41. destacar · Highlighting a key point
lessons.objective: 41. destacar · Highlighting a key point: Destacar can highlight something or stand out.
lessons.focus: 41. destacar · Highlighting a key point

words.es: Quiero destacar tres cambios del horario.
words.en: I want to highlight three schedule changes.

words.es: La directora destacó la importancia de llegar a tiempo.
words.en: The director highlighted the importance of arriving on time.

words.es: En el resumen destacamos las tareas que faltan.
words.en: In the summary we highlight the tasks that remain.

words.es: ¿Puedes destacar la fecha con otro color?
words.en: Can you highlight the date with another color?

words.es: La propuesta de Ana destaca por su claridad.
words.en: Ana's proposal stands out for its clarity.

words.es: Todos entendimos qué debía hacerse primero.
words.en: We all understood what should be done first.

words.es: Una compañera preguntó cuál de los cambios era obligatorio.
words.en: A coworker asked which of the changes was required.

words.es: Le mostré la frase que había marcado en el documento.
words.en: I showed her the sentence I had marked in the document.

lessons.speaking: You and a Spanish-speaking classmate are discussing highlighting a key point. Destacar can highlight something or stand out. Destaco is regular present; destaqué and destaque preserve pronunciation with qu. Ask for the missing detail, respond to the partner, clarify one misunderstanding, and agree on the next step. Use examples from the reading and your own details. Explain the grammar in English if asked.

grammar.focus: Destacar can highlight something or stand out. Destaco is regular present; destaqué and destaque preserve pronunciation with qu.

examples.es: Quiero destacar tres cambios del horario.
examples.en: I want to highlight three schedule changes.

examples.es: La directora destacó la importancia de llegar a tiempo.
examples.en: The director highlighted the importance of arriving on time.

lessons.title: 42. existir · Whether something exists
lessons.objective: 42. existir · Whether something exists: Existir is a regular -ir verb.
lessons.focus: 42. existir · Whether something exists

words.es: Existe otra opción para el grupo de la tarde.
words.en: There is another option for the afternoon group.
Two copies of the document exist.

words.es: Antes no existía un horario de fin de semana.
words.en: Previously there was no weekend schedule.

words.es: No sabíamos que existieran tantas posibilidades.
words.en: We did not know that so many possibilities existed.

words.es: La coordinadora explicó qué diferencias había entre ellas.
words.en: The coordinator explained what differences there were between them.

words.es: Ahora podemos elegir con más información.
words.en: Now we can choose with more information.

words.es: La primera opción era más barata, pero quedaba lejos.
words.en: The first option was cheaper, but it was far away.

words.es: La segunda tenía menos espacio y un horario más flexible.
words.en: The second had less space and a more flexible schedule.

lessons.speaking: You and a Spanish-speaking classmate are discussing whether something exists. Existir is a regular -ir verb. It agrees with its subject, unlike impersonal hay: existe una opción / existen dos opciones. Ask for the missing detail, respond to the partner, clarify one misunderstanding, and agree on the next step. Use examples from the reading and your own details. Explain the grammar in English if asked.

grammar.focus: Existir is a regular -ir verb. It agrees with its subject, unlike impersonal hay: existe una opción / existen dos opciones.

examples.es: Existe otra opción para el grupo de la tarde.
examples.en: There is another option for the afternoon group.

examples.es: Existen dos copias del documento.
examples.en: Two copies of the document exist.

lessons.title: 43. mostrar · Showing something to someone
lessons.objective: 43. mostrar · Showing something to someone: Mostrar changes o to ue in stressed present forms; mostramos keeps o.
lessons.focus: 43. mostrar · Showing something to someone

words.es: Muestro el mapa a las personas que llegan.
words.en: I show the map to the people who arrive.

words.es: Ayer Ana nos mostró la sala nueva.
words.en: Yesterday Ana showed us the new room.

words.es: Queremos mostrar cómo funciona la reserva.
words.en: We want to show how the booking works.

words.es: ¿Puedes mostrarme dónde está la entrada lateral?
words.en: Can you show me where the side entrance is?

words.es: Es importante que mostremos el mismo horario a todos.
words.en: It is important that we show everyone the same schedule.
That way we will avoid contradictory messages.

words.es: Un visitante dijo que no podía leer los números pequeños.
words.en: A visitor said he could not read the small numbers.

words.es: Ana buscó una copia más grande del mapa.
words.en: Ana looked for a larger copy of the map.

lessons.speaking: You and a Spanish-speaking classmate are discussing showing something to someone. Mostrar changes o to ue in stressed present forms; mostramos keeps o. Mostrar algo a alguien can combine with an indirect-object pronoun. Ask for the missing detail, respond to the partner, clarify one misunderstanding, and agree on the next step. Use examples from the reading and your own details. Explain the grammar in English if asked.

grammar.focus: Mostrar changes o to ue in stressed present forms; mostramos keeps o. Mostrar algo a alguien can combine with an indirect-object pronoun.

examples.es: Muestro el mapa a las personas que llegan.
examples.en: I show the map to the people who arrive.

examples.es: Ayer Ana nos mostró la sala nueva.
examples.en: Yesterday Ana showed us the new room.

lessons.title: 44. producir · Producing a result
lessons.objective: 44. producir · Producing a result: Producir uses produzco in present yo and strong preterite produje / produjeron.
lessons.focus: 44. producir · Producing a result

words.es: El centro produce materiales para los estudiantes.
words.en: The center produces materials for students.

words.es: Este cambio produce más trabajo al principio.
words.en: This change creates more work at first.

words.es: El error produjo una confusión con las fechas.
words.en: The error caused confusion about the dates.

words.es: Ayer se produjo un retraso en la entrega.
words.en: Yesterday there was a delay in the delivery.

words.es: No queremos que el mismo problema se produzca otra vez.
words.en: We do not want the same problem to occur again.

words.es: Por eso revisaremos la lista antes de enviarla.
words.en: That is why we will check the list before sending it.

words.es: El encargado explicó que la dirección no estaba completa.
words.en: The person in charge explained that the address was incomplete.

words.es: Habíamos escrito la calle, pero faltaba el número de la sala.
words.en: We had written the street, but the room number was missing.

lessons.speaking: You and a Spanish-speaking classmate are discussing producing a result. Producir uses produzco in present yo and strong preterite produje / produjeron. Producirse can describe an event occurring. Ask for the missing detail, respond to the partner, clarify one misunderstanding, and agree on the next step. Use examples from the reading and your own details. Explain the grammar in English if asked.

grammar.focus: Producir uses produzco in present yo and strong preterite produje / produjeron. Producirse can describe an event occurring.

examples.es: El centro produce materiales para los estudiantes.
examples.en: The center produces materials for students.

examples.es: Este cambio produce más trabajo al principio.
examples.en: This change creates more work at first.

lessons.title: 45. abrir · Opening versus being open
lessons.objective: 45. abrir · Opening versus being open: Abrir has regular present and preterite forms but participle abierto.
lessons.focus: 45. abrir · Opening versus being open

words.es: Abro la sala cuando llega el primer grupo.
words.en: I open the room when the first group arrives.

words.es: Ayer abrimos también la entrada lateral.
words.en: Yesterday we also opened the side entrance.

words.es: La recepcionista ya ha abierto el archivo.
words.en: The receptionist has already opened the file.
Can you open the window for a moment?

words.es: No abras la carpeta que tiene datos privados.
words.en: Do not open the folder that has private details.

words.es: La copia para visitantes está en otra carpeta.
words.en: The visitor copy is in another folder.

words.es: Mi compañero preguntó si la puerta debía quedar abierta.
words.en: My coworker asked whether the door should remain open.

words.es: Le expliqué que solo debía abrirse al llegar el grupo.
words.en: I explained that it should only be opened when the group arrived.

lessons.speaking: You and a Spanish-speaking classmate are discussing opening versus being open. Abrir has regular present and preterite forms but participle abierto. Estar abierto describes a state; haber abierto describes an action completed. Ask for the missing detail, respond to the partner, clarify one misunderstanding, and agree on the next step. Use examples from the reading and your own details. Explain the grammar in English if asked.

grammar.focus: Abrir has regular present and preterite forms but participle abierto. Estar abierto describes a state; haber abierto describes an action completed.

examples.es: Abro la sala cuando llega el primer grupo.
examples.en: I open the room when the first group arrives.

examples.es: Ayer abrimos también la entrada lateral.
examples.en: Yesterday we also opened the side entrance.

lessons.title: 46. esperar · Waiting, expecting and hoping
lessons.objective: 46. esperar · Waiting, expecting and hoping: Esperar takes different senses from context.
lessons.focus: 46. esperar · Waiting, expecting and hoping

words.es: Esperamos a la coordinadora en la entrada.
words.en: We wait for the coordinator at the entrance.

words.es: Ella espera que terminemos antes del viernes.
words.en: She hopes we finish before Friday.

words.es: Ayer esperamos casi una hora por la entrega.
words.en: Yesterday we waited almost an hour for the delivery.

words.es: No esperes afuera si hace frío.
words.en: Do not wait outside if it is cold.

words.es: Si la oficina hubiera respondido antes, no habríamos esperado tanto.
words.en: If the office had answered earlier, we would not have waited so long.

words.es: La próxima vez confirmaremos la hora por teléfono.
words.en: Next time we will confirm the time by phone.

words.es: La oficina reconoció que había enviado una hora incorrecta.
words.en: The office acknowledged that it had sent an incorrect time.

words.es: La persona que llamó nos pidió disculpas.
words.en: The person who called apologized to us.

lessons.speaking: You and a Spanish-speaking classmate are discussing waiting, expecting and hoping. Esperar takes different senses from context. Esperar que expressing a hope commonly takes subjunctive; esperar a alguien waits for a person. Ask for the missing detail, respond to the partner, clarify one misunderstanding, and agree on the next step. Use examples from the reading and your own details. Explain the grammar in English if asked.

grammar.focus: Esperar takes different senses from context. Esperar que expressing a hope commonly takes subjunctive; esperar a alguien waits for a person.

examples.es: Esperamos a la coordinadora en la entrada.
examples.en: We wait for the coordinator at the entrance.

examples.es: Ella espera que terminemos antes del viernes.
examples.en: She hopes we finish before Friday.

lessons.title: 47. considerar · Considering a possibility
lessons.objective: 47. considerar · Considering a possibility: Considerar is regular and can evaluate an option or regard something as a certain quality.
lessons.focus: 47. considerar · Considering a possibility

words.es: Consideramos cambiar el lugar de la reunión.
words.en: We are considering changing the meeting place.

words.es: Ana considera que la sala nueva es más cómoda.
words.en: Ana considers the new room more comfortable.
Yesterday we considered three different proposals.
Have you considered the travel time?

words.es: Es mejor que consideremos también las necesidades del grupo de la tarde.
words.en: It is better if we also consider the afternoon group's needs.

words.es: Después podremos tomar una decisión informada.
words.en: Afterward we will be able to make an informed decision.

words.es: Una compañera señaló que faltaba comparar los gastos de limpieza.
words.en: A coworker pointed out that the cleaning costs still needed to be compared.

words.es: La sala más barata no incluía ese servicio.
words.en: The cheaper room did not include that service.

lessons.speaking: You and a Spanish-speaking classmate are discussing considering a possibility. Considerar is regular and can evaluate an option or regard something as a certain quality. Considering a proposal does not assert that it has been accepted. Ask for the missing detail, respond to the partner, clarify one misunderstanding, and agree on the next step. Use examples from the reading and your own details. Explain the grammar in English if asked.

grammar.focus: Considerar is regular and can evaluate an option or regard something as a certain quality. Considering a proposal does not assert that it has been accepted.

examples.es: Consideramos cambiar el lugar de la reunión.
examples.en: We are considering changing the meeting place.

examples.es: Ana considera que la sala nueva es más cómoda.
examples.en: Ana considers the new room more comfortable.

lessons.title: 48. vivir · Residence, former habits and experience
lessons.objective: 48. vivir · Residence, former habits and experience: Vivir en names where someone lives; vivir una experiencia describes experiencing it.
lessons.focus: 48. vivir · Residence, former habits and experience

words.es: Vivo cerca del centro desde hace dos años.
words.en: I have lived near the center for two years.

words.es: Antes vivía al otro lado de la ciudad.
words.en: I used to live on the other side of the city.
I lived there for five years.

words.es: Mi compañera ha vivido una experiencia parecida.
words.en: My coworker has had a similar experience.

words.es: Si viviéramos más cerca, caminaríamos juntos al trabajo.
words.en: If we lived closer, we would walk to work together.

words.es: Por ahora nos encontramos en la estación.
words.en: For now we meet at the station.

words.es: Le conté a mi compañera cómo había cambiado el barrio.
words.en: I told my coworker how the neighborhood had changed.

words.es: Ahora había una biblioteca nueva cerca de mi casa.
words.en: Now there was a new library near my home.

lessons.speaking: You and a Spanish-speaking classmate are discussing residence, former habits and experience. Vivir en names where someone lives; vivir una experiencia describes experiencing it. Present vivo, preterite viví and imperfect vivía express different viewpoints. Ask for the missing detail, respond to the partner, clarify one misunderstanding, and agree on the next step. Use examples from the reading and your own details. Explain the grammar in English if asked.

grammar.focus: Vivir en names where someone lives; vivir una experiencia describes experiencing it. Present vivo, preterite viví and imperfect vivía express different viewpoints.

examples.es: Vivo cerca del centro desde hace dos años.
examples.en: I have lived near the center for two years.

examples.es: Antes vivía al otro lado de la ciudad.
examples.en: I used to live on the other side of the city.

lessons.title: 49. mantener · Keeping something in a condition
lessons.objective: 49. mantener · Keeping something in a condition: Mantener follows tener in many irregular forms: mantengo, mantuve, mantendré.
lessons.focus: 49. mantener · Keeping something in a condition

words.en: We keep the information up to date.

words.es: Yo mantengo una copia de cada versión.
words.en: I keep a copy of each version.

words.es: La coordinadora mantuvo la fecha original.
words.en: The coordinator kept the original date.

words.es: Es importante que mantengamos el mismo criterio.
words.en: It is important that we maintain the same criterion.

words.es: Mantendremos el horario si todos pueden asistir.
words.en: We will keep the schedule if everyone can attend.

words.es: Si surge un problema, hablaremos con el grupo.
words.en: If a problem arises, we will talk with the group.

words.es: Un participante preguntó quién actualizaba la lista de contactos.
words.en: A participant asked who updated the contact list.

words.es: La directora explicó que cada grupo mantenía su propia copia.
words.en: The director explained that each group kept its own copy.

lessons.speaking: You and a Spanish-speaking classmate are discussing keeping something in a condition. Mantener follows tener in many irregular forms: mantengo, mantuve, mantendré. It can mean maintain, keep or sustain, depending on the object. Ask for the missing detail, respond to the partner, clarify one misunderstanding, and agree on the next step. Use examples from the reading and your own details. Explain the grammar in English if asked.

grammar.focus: Mantener follows tener in many irregular forms: mantengo, mantuve, mantendré. It can mean maintain, keep or sustain, depending on the object.

examples.es: Mantenemos la información actualizada.
examples.en: We keep the information up to date.

examples.es: Yo mantengo una copia de cada versión.
examples.en: I keep a copy of each version.

lessons.title: 50. pensar · Thinking about and intending
lessons.objective: 50. pensar · Thinking about and intending: Pensar en names what occupies thought; pensar + infinitive can express an intention.
lessons.focus: 50. pensar · Thinking about and intending

words.es: Pienso en una forma más sencilla de organizar las copias.
words.en: I am thinking about a simpler way to organize the copies.

words.es: Ana piensa preparar una carpeta para cada grupo.
words.en: Ana intends to prepare a folder for each group.

words.es: Ayer pensamos que faltaban dos documentos.
words.en: Yesterday we thought two documents were missing.

words.es: ¿Qué pensarías de empezar una hora antes?
words.en: What would you think about starting an hour earlier?

words.es: No quiero que pensemos solo en el precio.
words.en: I do not want us to think only about the price.

words.es: También debemos considerar el tiempo de cada persona.
words.en: We should also consider each person's time.

words.es: Ana pensaba que la carpeta nueva sería más difícil de usar.
words.en: Ana thought the new folder would be harder to use.

words.es: Le pedí que probara el ejemplo antes de decidir.
words.en: I asked her to try the example before deciding.

lessons.speaking: You and a Spanish-speaking classmate are discussing thinking about and intending. Pensar en names what occupies thought; pensar + infinitive can express an intention. Pienso changes e to ie, but pensamos keeps e. Ask for the missing detail, respond to the partner, clarify one misunderstanding, and agree on the next step. Use examples from the reading and your own details. Explain the grammar in English if asked.

grammar.focus: Pensar en names what occupies thought; pensar + infinitive can express an intention. Pienso changes e to ie, but pensamos keeps e.

examples.es: Pienso en una forma más sencilla de organizar las copias.
examples.en: I am thinking about a simpler way to organize the copies.

examples.es: Ana piensa preparar una carpeta para cada grupo.
examples.en: Ana intends to prepare a folder for each group.

lessons.title: 51. partir · Leaving, splitting and starting from a basis
lessons.objective: 51. partir · Leaving, splitting and starting from a basis: Partir can depart or divide something.
lessons.focus: 51. partir · Leaving, splitting and starting from a basis

words.es: El autobús parte de la estación a las siete.
words.en: The bus leaves the station at seven.

words.es: Ayer partimos la tarea en dos partes.
words.en: Yesterday we split the task into two parts.

words.es: Nuestra propuesta parte de una necesidad del grupo.
words.en: Our proposal starts from a group need.

words.es: A partir del lunes usaremos el horario nuevo.
words.en: Starting Monday we will use the new schedule.

words.es: Antes de partir, confirmaremos la dirección.
words.en: Before leaving, we will confirm the address.

words.es: Después podremos explicar el plan a quienes llegan más tarde.
words.en: Afterward we will be able to explain the plan to those who arrive later.

words.es: Antes de partir, repartimos las copias del mapa.
words.en: Before leaving, we handed out the map copies.

words.es: Una persona propuso partir el recorrido en dos tramos.
words.en: One person proposed dividing the route into two sections.

lessons.speaking: You and a Spanish-speaking classmate are discussing leaving, splitting and starting from a basis. Partir can depart or divide something. A partir de means starting from; partir de una idea means take an idea as a starting point. Ask for the missing detail, respond to the partner, clarify one misunderstanding, and agree on the next step. Use examples from the reading and your own details. Explain the grammar in English if asked.

grammar.focus: Partir can depart or divide something. A partir de means starting from; partir de una idea means take an idea as a starting point.

examples.es: El autobús parte de la estación a las siete.
examples.en: The bus leaves the station at seven.

examples.es: Ayer partimos la tarea en dos partes.
examples.en: Yesterday we split the task into two parts.

lessons.title: 52. venir · Coming and movement toward a reference point
lessons.objective: 52. venir · Coming and movement toward a reference point: Venir generally approaches a speaker or reference point, compared with ir.
lessons.focus: 52. venir · Coming and movement toward a reference point

words.es: Vengo al centro en bicicleta cuando no llueve.
words.en: I come to the center by bicycle when it does not rain.

words.es: Ayer vino una compañera de otra oficina.
words.en: Yesterday a coworker from another office came.
Tomorrow two new students will come.

words.es: Espero que vengan con tiempo para recorrer el edificio.
words.en: I hope they come with time to tour the building.

words.es: Si hubieran venido ayer, habrían conocido a la directora.
words.en: If they had come yesterday, they would have met the director.
We can introduce them to her next week.

words.es: La directora nos avisó que volvería el martes.
words.en: The director told us she would return on Tuesday.

words.es: Le preguntamos si podía venir a la primera parte del taller.
words.en: We asked her whether she could come to the first part of the workshop.

lessons.speaking: You and a Spanish-speaking classmate are discussing coming and movement toward a reference point. Venir generally approaches a speaker or reference point, compared with ir. Vengo, vine and vendré show different irregular stems. Ask for the missing detail, respond to the partner, clarify one misunderstanding, and agree on the next step. Use examples from the reading and your own details. Explain the grammar in English if asked.

grammar.focus: Venir generally approaches a speaker or reference point, compared with ir. Vengo, vine and vendré show different irregular stems.

examples.es: Vengo al centro en bicicleta cuando no llueve.
examples.en: I come to the center by bicycle when it does not rain.

examples.es: Ayer vino una compañera de otra oficina.
examples.en: Yesterday a coworker from another office came.

lessons.title: 53. comenzar · Starting and sequencing a task
lessons.objective: 53. comenzar · Starting and sequencing a task: Comenzar a + infinitive starts an activity.
lessons.focus: 53. comenzar · Starting and sequencing a task

words.es: Comienzo a revisar los mensajes antes de abrir la sala.
words.en: I start checking messages before opening the room.

words.es: Ayer comenzamos la reunión con una pregunta.
words.en: Yesterday we began the meeting with a question.

words.es: La directora comenzó a explicar el cambio de horario.
words.en: The director began to explain the schedule change.

words.es: ¿A qué hora comenzará el taller del viernes?
words.en: What time will Friday's workshop begin?

words.es: Es mejor que comencemos por las tareas más urgentes.
words.en: It is better if we start with the most urgent tasks.

words.es: Después podremos dedicar tiempo a los detalles.
words.en: Afterward we will be able to devote time to the details.

words.es: Una participante explicó que faltaba una copia del material.
words.en: A participant explained that one copy of the material was missing.

words.es: Decidimos no comenzar la actividad hasta resolverlo.
words.en: We decided not to begin the activity until resolving it.

lessons.speaking: You and a Spanish-speaking classmate are discussing starting and sequencing a task. Comenzar a + infinitive starts an activity. Comienzo changes the stem in the present; comencé changes spelling in yo preterite. Ask for the missing detail, respond to the partner, clarify one misunderstanding, and agree on the next step. Use examples from the reading and your own details. Explain the grammar in English if asked.

grammar.focus: Comenzar a + infinitive starts an activity. Comienzo changes the stem in the present; comencé changes spelling in yo preterite.

examples.es: Comienzo a revisar los mensajes antes de abrir la sala.
examples.en: I start checking messages before opening the room.

examples.es: Ayer comenzamos la reunión con una pregunta.
examples.en: Yesterday we began the meeting with a question.

lessons.title: 54. tomar · Transport, drinks and decisions
lessons.objective: 54. tomar · Transport, drinks and decisions: Tomar combines with nouns to express different activities: tomar el tren, tomar agua, tomar una decisión.
lessons.focus: 54. tomar · Transport, drinks and decisions

words.es: Tomamos el tren para llegar al centro.
words.en: We take the train to get to the center.

words.es: Durante la pausa tomé un café.
words.en: During the break I had a coffee.

words.es: El grupo tomó una decisión después de hablar.
words.en: The group made a decision after talking.

words.es: No tomes los documentos de otra persona sin preguntar.
words.en: Do not take another person's documents without asking.

words.es: Si hubiéramos tomado la otra ruta, habríamos llegado tarde.
words.en: If we had taken the other route, we would have arrived late.

words.es: Mañana revisaremos el horario antes de salir.
words.en: Tomorrow we will check the schedule before leaving.

words.es: La coordinadora preguntó por qué habíamos tomado esa decisión.
words.en: The coordinator asked why we had made that decision.

words.es: Le mostramos el horario que habíamos comparado.
words.en: We showed her the schedule we had compared.

lessons.speaking: You and a Spanish-speaking classmate are discussing transport, drinks and decisions. Tomar combines with nouns to express different activities: tomar el tren, tomar agua, tomar una decisión. It does not always translate as take. Ask for the missing detail, respond to the partner, clarify one misunderstanding, and agree on the next step. Use examples from the reading and your own details. Explain the grammar in English if asked.

grammar.focus: Tomar combines with nouns to express different activities: tomar el tren, tomar agua, tomar una decisión. It does not always translate as take.

examples.es: Tomamos el tren para llegar al centro.
examples.en: We take the train to get to the center.

examples.es: Durante la pausa tomé un café.
examples.en: During the break I had a coffee.

lessons.title: 55. formar · Forming a group and being part of it
lessons.objective: 55. formar · Forming a group and being part of it: Formar un grupo creates a group; formar parte de means be part of.
lessons.focus: 55. formar · Forming a group and being part of it

words.es: Formamos un grupo para preparar la bienvenida.
words.en: We form a group to prepare the welcome.

words.es: Ana forma parte del equipo de la tarde.
words.en: Ana is part of the afternoon team.

words.es: Ayer se formó una fila junto a recepción.
words.en: Yesterday a line formed next to reception.

words.es: Queremos formar parejas para revisar los documentos.
words.en: We want to form pairs to review the documents.

words.es: La coordinadora pidió que formáramos grupos pequeños.
words.en: The coordinator asked us to form small groups.

words.es: Así todos podrán participar en la conversación.
words.en: That way everyone will be able to participate in the conversation.

words.es: Al principio nadie sabía cómo formar las parejas.
words.en: At first nobody knew how to form the pairs.

words.es: Una participante sugirió combinar a personas de grupos distintos.
words.en: One participant suggested pairing people from different groups.

lessons.title: 56. suponer · Assuming and what something entails
lessons.objective: 56. suponer · Assuming and what something entails: Suponer follows poner in many forms: supongo, supuse, supondré.
lessons.focus: 56. suponer · Assuming and what something entails

words.es: Supongo que la oficina abrirá a las nueve.
words.en: I assume the office will open at nine.

words.es: Ayer supusimos que todos habían recibido el mensaje.
words.en: Yesterday we assumed everyone had received the message.

words.es: El cambio supone revisar todas las reservas.
words.en: The change entails reviewing all the bookings.

words.es: No supongas que una copia antigua sigue siendo válida.
words.en: Do not assume an old copy is still valid.

words.es: Si hubiéramos confirmado la fecha, no habríamos supuesto tanto.
words.en: If we had confirmed the date, we would not have assumed so much.

words.es: Ahora vamos a comprobar cada dato importante.
words.en: Now we are going to check each important detail.

words.es: Una persona había supuesto que la sala seguía reservada.
words.en: One person had assumed the room was still booked.

words.es: Otra había supuesto que alguien más había llamado.
words.en: Another had assumed that someone else had called.

lessons.speaking: You and a Spanish-speaking classmate are discussing assuming and what something entails. Suponer follows poner in many forms: supongo, supuse, supondré. lessons.title: 57. escribir · Writing and keeping a written record
lessons.objective: 57. escribir · Writing and keeping a written record: Escribir is regular in the present and preterite but has irregular participle escrito.
lessons.focus: 57. escribir · Writing and keeping a written record

words.es: Escribo un resumen después de cada reunión.
words.en: I write a summary after each meeting.

words.es: Ana escribió las nuevas fechas en el calendario.
words.en: Ana wrote the new dates on the calendar.

words.es: Ya hemos escrito a todos los participantes.
words.en: We have already written to all the participants.

words.es: ¿Habías escrito el número de contacto en la primera página?
words.en: Had you written the contact number on the first page?

words.es: Es importante que escribamos los nombres correctamente.
words.en: It is important that we write the names correctly.

words.es: Antes de enviar la copia, los compararemos con la lista original.
words.en: Before sending the copy, we will compare them with the original list.

words.es: La primera copia tenía dos apellidos en el orden incorrecto.
words.en: The first copy had two surnames in the wrong order.

words.es: Una compañera señaló el error antes de que enviáramos el mensaje.
words.en: A coworker pointed out the mistake before we sent the message.

lessons.speaking: You and a Spanish-speaking classmate are discussing writing and keeping a written record. Escribir is regular in the present and preterite but has irregular participle escrito. With haber the participle does not agree with the subject or object. Ask for the missing detail, respond to the partner, clarify one misunderstanding, and agree on the next step. Use examples from the reading and your own details. Explain the grammar in English if asked.

grammar.focus: Escribir is regular in the present and preterite but has irregular participle escrito. With haber the participle does not agree with the subject or object.

examples.es: Escribo un resumen después de cada reunión.
examples.en: I write a summary after each meeting.

examples.es: Ana escribió las nuevas fechas en el calendario.
examples.en: Ana wrote the new dates on the calendar.

lessons.title: 58. explicar · Explaining clearly to a listener
lessons.objective: 58. explicar · Explaining clearly to a listener: Explicar algo a alguien names the content and listener.
lessons.focus: 58. explicar · Explaining clearly to a listener

words.es: Explico el plan con un ejemplo sencillo.
words.en: I explain the plan with a simple example.

words.es: Ayer la coordinadora nos explicó el cambio de sala.
words.en: Yesterday the coordinator explained the room change to us.

words.es: ¿Puedes explicar por qué falta una fecha?
words.en: Can you explain why a date is missing?

words.es: No expliqué que el documento todavía era provisional.
words.en: I did not explain that the document was still provisional.

words.es: Si lo hubiera explicado mejor, habríamos evitado la confusión.
words.en: If I had explained it better, we would have avoided the confusion.

words.es: Ahora voy a resumir los pasos y pedir que los repitan.
words.en: Now I am going to summarize the steps and ask them to repeat them.

words.es: Un compañero repitió el plan con sus propias palabras.
words.en: A coworker repeated the plan in his own words.

words.es: Al escucharlo, noté qué parte no había explicado bien.
words.en: On listening to him, I noticed which part I had not explained well.

lessons.speaking: You and a Spanish-speaking classmate are discussing explaining clearly to a listener. Explicar algo a alguien names the content and listener. Use examples from the reading and your own details. Explain the grammar in English if asked.

words.en: I obtain the information at the central office.

words.es: Ayer obtuvimos permiso para usar la sala.
words.en: Yesterday we obtained permission to use the room.
Have you obtained a written answer?

words.es: La coordinadora quiere que obtengamos dos presupuestos.
words.en: The coordinator wants us to obtain two quotes.

words.es: Si obtenemos la confirmación hoy, podremos reservar mañana.
words.en: If we obtain confirmation today, we will be able to book tomorrow.

words.es: Mientras tanto guardaremos todas las opciones en una carpeta.
words.en: Meanwhile we will keep all the options in one folder.

words.es: El primer presupuesto no incluía todos los materiales.
words.en: The first quote did not include all the materials.

words.es: Ana llamó para obtener una versión completa.
words.en: Ana called to obtain a complete version.

lessons.title: 60. perder · Losing an item, missing transport and wasting time

lessons.focus: 60. perder · Losing an item, missing transport and wasting time

words.es: A veces pierdo tiempo buscando mensajes antiguos.
words.en: Sometimes I waste time looking for old messages.

words.es: Ayer perdí la copia que necesitaba.
words.en: Yesterday I lost the copy I needed.

words.es: Mi compañera perdió el autobús por esperar la firma.
words.en: My coworker missed the bus because she waited for the signature.

words.es: No quiero que perdamos otra oportunidad de reunirnos.
words.en: I do not want us to miss another opportunity to meet.

words.es: Si hubiéramos organizado la carpeta, no habríamos perdido tanto tiempo.
words.en: If we had organized the folder, we would not have wasted so much time.

words.es: Desde ahora guardaremos cada documento en el lugar acordado.
words.en: From now on we will save each document in the agreed place.

words.es: La coordinadora preguntó qué habíamos aprendido del problema.
words.en: The coordinator asked what we had learned from the problem.

words.es: Le dije que perder un archivo no debía detener todo el trabajo.
words.en: I told her that losing a file should not stop all the work.

lessons.speaking: You and a Spanish-speaking classmate are discussing losing an item, missing transport and wasting time. Perder covers losing, missing transport and wasting time. Use examples from the reading and your own details. Explain the grammar in English if asked.
